current_queue_tie_bridge_proxy: A diagnostic-only, non-Round-7 proxy: the two largest current raw queues differ by at most 10 percent of the largest queue. No Round-7 development or holdout artifact is read.
myopic_objective: lexicographically maximize current projected payload; then minimize radial action norm; then stable candidate order
planner: finite action lattice rollout; evaluate each first action and use the pre-registered queue_rate_energy continuation
